home.description: Three shops in Higashiyama, Kyoto, near Kiyomizu-dera. Japanese pottery, tea ceremony tools, old tools and hanging scrolls, plus anime figures and Pokémon cards. Open every day 10:00–20:00, English spoken.

home.h1: Taketora, an antique shop in Higashiyama, Kyoto
home.lead:
Old pottery on one shelf.
Anime figures on the next.
home.body: We run three shops in Higashiyama, Kyoto. Right next to the shelves of Kiyomizu and Kutani ware, iron kettles and hanging scrolls, you'll find One Piece and Dragon Ball figures and boxes of Pokémon cards. Old or new, pick up anything that catches your eye.

antique.name: Antiques & old tools
antique.body: Kiyomizu, Imari and Kutani ware. Tea bowls, tea caddies and other tea ceremony tools, iron kettles, old chests, hanging scrolls and ukiyo-e prints.

figures.name: Anime figures
figures.body: Mostly prize figures, stacked along whole walls. Second-hand pieces are graded by condition.

pokemon.name: Pokémon cards
pokemon.body: Sealed booster boxes and more. Looking for something specific? DM us on Instagram and we'll check.
